description: An autumn residential front entry photographed in warm late-afternoon golden light. The entry porch architecture combines a contemporary mid-century modern flat-roof overhang with warm teak or cedar wood soffit planking and a black painted fascia, sitting on rough-textured white stucco or plaster wall surfaces with a deeply raked organic texture. A wide pivot-style front door in rich warm walnut or teak wood grain with a slim elongated black metal handle is flanked by tall narrow sidelight glazed panels in a black metal frame, offering glimpses of a warm amber-lit interior beyond. To the right, a red brick wall transitions to the white stucco, marking the boundary of the entry alcove. The porch step is smooth poured concrete. Two matching ornate cast iron urn planters on each side of the doorstep overflow with bright yellow chrysanthemums and vivid red-orange fall blooms. A clipped topiary cone in dark green sits at the lower right corner. The garden setting is bathed in the warm amber and gold tones of autumn — fallen maple leaves in rust, ochre, and crimson litter the driveway. Mature deciduous trees in peak fall color — orange, amber, and rust — surround the property. On the right stucco wall face beside the door, a vertical cylindrical matte black outdoor form with a warm amber linear slit glow is wall-mounted, casting a warm column of light against the white textured stucco surface. Camera at standing eye-level, centered composition facing directly into the entry, normal lens, full facade in frame.
